subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should plugin hooks receive a documented current-session reset capability, and if so must it be deferred until the active run exits rather than exposing the general Gateway reset service?
rationale: This changes the public plugin hook contract and session lifecycle ownership; code review can identify the unsafe synchronous implementation, but maintainers must confirm whether plugins should own this capability at all.

options.title: Add deferred scoped reset
options.body: Expose a no-key or current-session-only request that queues the reset after run completion and document it as a supported plugin API.

options.title: Keep hooks observational
options.body: Remove the new API and solve the stale-session symptom inside the owning context engine or a core post-compaction policy path.

recommendation.title: Add deferred scoped reset
recommendation.body: Expose a no-key or current-session-only request that queues the reset after run completion and document it as a supported plugin API.

likelyOwner.reason: The context-engine compaction delegation and plugin SDK boundary introduced in `7f0f8dd268` most directly governs where this capability should live.
